answer.rationale: Do not respond to the competitor with broad promotional pricing: the recovered price-sensitive SMB experiment produced a 30-day retention decline despite acquisition and initial revenue lift, making it misaligned with sustainable qualified revenue. Referral incentives have added qualified revenue from established customers without measurable retention harm. Run a bounded expansion among established customers while monitoring referral quality, incentive cost, and cohort retention; this does not assume it will directly neutralize price-driven SMB churn.
